skill.name: visioncraft
skill.description: Generate images and videos through Agnes AI using PowerShell scripts. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and keyframe animation.
skill.summary: Create Agnes AI images and videos from natural language prompts.
skill.author: BAI-32

security_audit.summary: VisionCraft is a disclosed creative media skill that runs local PowerShell scripts and calls Agnes AI HTTPS APIs. The audit found no prompt-injection text, hidden command execution, or evidence of credential exfiltration beyond the intended AGNES_API_KEY Authorization header. Remaining concerns are user-visible third-party API transmission, local script execution, and unscanned binary image assets.

remediation.suggestion: Keep Agnes AI network use explicit in the skill description and require user confirmation before sending private prompts, image URLs, or reference media to the service.
Continue reading AGNES_API_KEY only from the environment, never log the token, and document how users can rotate the key if exposed.
Document the exact scripts invoked and avoid adding dynamic command construction or shell execution around user prompts.
Manually review or regenerate the PNG showcase assets before publication, and keep binary assets minimal.

content.user_title: Create Agnes AI Images and Videos
content.value_statement: Creative teams need fast visual drafts without writing API requests by hand. VisionCraft turns natural language prompts into Agnes AI image and video generation workflows for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts using the Agnes Image API.
Transforms public image URLs with image-to-image prompts.
Creates videos from text prompts with configurable aspect ratio and duration.
Animates one or more image URLs into video clips.
Supports keyframe animation between multiple reference images.
Prints generated media URLs in a clear MEDIA output format.
limitations: Requires PowerShell 7 or compatible PowerShell execution.
Requires a valid Agnes AI API key in AGNES_API_KEY.
Sends prompts and image URLs to the external Agnes AI service.
Does not download generated media unless the user asks.

use_cases.title: Draft campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Generate poster concepts, product scenes, and social media visuals from short creative briefs.

use_cases.title: Prototype video ideas
use_cases.description: Create short video clips or animations before committing to full production work.

use_cases.title: Explore keyframe motion
use_cases.description: Blend two reference images into a smooth transition for concept review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a modern coffee shop exterior at sunrise, warm lighting, realistic style.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle an existing image
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform this image into a cyberpunk night scene while preserving the main composition: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Create a short video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 6 second vertical video of a cyclist riding through a futuristic city, smooth tracking camera, neon reflections.

prompt_templates.title: Animate between keyframes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these two images as keyframes and create a smooth cinematic transition with consistent subject identity: [first URL], [second URL].

output_examples.input: Generate a fantasy harbor city at sunset.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a short success message and a MEDIA link to the generated image.

output_examples.input: Animate this product image into a rotating studio shot.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a video task, polls for completion, and returns a MEDIA link to the generated video.

output_examples.input: Morph from this sketch to this finished design.
output_examples.output: The skill uses keyframe mode and returns a generated transition video URL.

best_practices: Set AGNES_API_KEY before starting the workflow and keep it out of source control.
Include subject, scene, style, lighting, and camera direction in prompts.
Use public image URLs only when you are allowed to send them to Agnes AI.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private API keys into prompts or saved project files.
Do not send confidential images to the external API without approval.
Do not request local downloads unless you need persistent media files.

faq.question: What does VisionCraft generate?
faq.answer: It generates images, image transformations, videos, image animations, multi-image videos, and keyframe transitions through Agnes AI.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts require AGNES_API_KEY to be set in the environment before use.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts, image URLs, and the API authorization header are sent to Agnes AI endpoints.

faq.question: Can it use local image files directly?
faq.answer: The documented workflows use public HTTPS image URLs or data image URLs, not direct local file uploads.

faq.question: What happens when video generation takes too long?
faq.answer: The video script prints the video identifier so the user can check the result later.
